periods.time: coup flashbacks and Crossfield final crisis
periods.description: A mysterious golden flute whose tone can summon, hatch, or direct Abyss, used by Fugil in the coup flashback and by Belbet during the Crossfield crisis.
features: prevents controlled Abyss from attacking holder
history: Fugil claims he used it to summon Abyss during the coup
Belbet uses it to hatch Gargoyles from a large Abyss and command them
